purpose: FRTB IMA Expected Shortfall pre-validation: MC simulation across liquidity horizons LH1–LH5 (10/20/40/60/120 days), NMRF surcharge estimation, Monte-Carlo convergence diagnostic (green/amber/red; a simulation-scale self-check, NOT the regulatory P&L-attribution test), IMA vs SA-floor capital comparison. Educational pre-validator ahead of UK IMA go-live January 2028.
